description.zh: 文件资源名称，支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The name of the file resource. Supports fuzzy search.

description.zh: 负责人的ID，即工作空间管理员的账号UID。您可登录阿里云控制台后，在账号管理的安全管理中查看账号UID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the workspace administrator. You can log on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console and view the ID on the Security Settings page.

description.zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页。
description.en: The page number of the data to retrieve, used for pagination.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条。
description.en: The page number of the data to retrieve, used for pagination.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied.

- File
description.en:
The resource type. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

Valid values:

- Python

- Jar

- Archive

- File
